info.name: TownRate API
info.description:
Local Business Review Platform.

Run `npm run seed -- --fresh` first, then run the folders top to bottom (or use the Collection Runner). Login requests store tokens in collection variables and create requests store ids, so later requests work without copy-pasting.

Seeded accounts all use password `password123`.

File fields point to `sample-photo.png` (in this folder). In Postman, set Settings → Working directory to this folder, or re-select the file.

request.description: role defaults to "user". Timestamped email so it can be re-run.
Returns 503 if Firebase is not configured on the server, 401 for an invalid token.

body.raw:
{
  "name": "Brew Lab",
  "description": "Third-wave coffee and waffles",
  "category": "cafe",
  "tags": [
    "coffee",
    "waffles",
    "wifi"
  ],
  "address": {
    "street": "7 Waterfield Road",
    "city": "Mumbai",
    "state": "Maharashtra",
    "zip": "400050"
  },
  "latitude": 19.0607,
  "longitude": 72.8362,
  "phone": "+91 98200 22222",
  "website": "https://example.com"
}

request.description: category accepts an id, slug or name.
Select image files for "photos" (up to 5, max 5MB each). Stored in Firebase Storage, or ./uploads when Firebase is not configured.
Attach one or more images before sending.
